controls.label: Color
controls.qualification: Colour from Hubble's spectrum of the star. The poles are hotter and brighter than the equator, from a fit to interferometric images; the disc is unresolved in colour, and its darker edge follows a model limb-darkening law, not a measurement.
controls.notes: The colour of the Hubble Space Telescope's calibrated STIS spectrum of Vega, a CALSPEC flux standard. No resolved image of the surface is cast; the display axis is celestial north, a convention.
